payload.title: 8-Week Beginner Full-Body Fat-Loss Program (Bodyweight + Dumbbell)
payload.summary: A 3-day/week, 8-week full-body program for a true beginner training at home with just dumbbells and bodyweight, designed to support fat loss while preserving muscle through moderate-rep resistance training. Includes a week-6 deload.
safety_notes: No injuries were confirmed, but all exercises are low technical-complexity and appropriate for a true beginner.
Stop a set short of the target reps if form breaks down; form takes priority over hitting a number.
Deload in week 6 is intentional — resist the urge to push through it at full intensity.
